diagnosis.summary: The 2026-10-01 payments landing file has every payment_id twice with identical content (834 rows, 417 distinct). The duplicates fail the unique test, the payments/orders assertion and the row-count trend. fct_orders is empty and its tests were skipped. Proposed fix: deduplicate_on_ingest on payments.payment_id. Upstream should still be told about the doubled export.

root_cause.explanation: The payments export for 2026-10-01 contains each payment_id exactly twice with identical content. All rows belong to 2026-10-01 orders, so these are not stale rows from an earlier day. Staging does not dedupe, so the duplicates flow downstream. Why fct_orders is empty was not directly established. The likely cause is that failing upstream tests or models skipped it. I expect the rerun to confirm this.

evidence.claim: raw.payments 2026-10-01 has 834 rows, 417 distinct payment_ids, every one doubled identically
Extra rows are not stale or earlier-day; orders landing is normal and the header matches the contract
Failing checks are consistent with duplicates: unique test, row-count trend at 190%, payments/orders assertion
No dbt model changed and ingest config is default, so a model revert or column mapping does not apply
The runbook says identical in-file copies are fixed with deduplicate_on_ingest on the primary key
fct_orders has 0 rows for 2026-10-01 and its unique and not_null tests were skipped

alternatives_considered: request_upstream_redelivery: the runbook reserves it for stale rows from an earlier day, and these are identical in-file copies
revert_model_change: no models differ from the deployed version
apply_column_mapping or ignore_extra_columns: the header matches the contract
escalate_to_owner (analytics_engineering): the fct_orders emptiness is unexplained, but raw orders are unique and no model changed, so the cause is likely upstream of the mart
rerun_only: the duplicates are in the landing file, so a rerun would fail again

proposal.rationale: The 2026-10-01 payments file has every payment_id exactly twice with identical content (Cause A: exact duplicates within one file, not stale rows). Deduping on payment_id restores 417 rows, fixes the unique test, row-count trend and payments/orders assertion, and unblocks fct_orders.

applied: ingest now keeps one row per payment_id when loading raw.payments
